name.value: Super 8 by Wyndham Lake Country/Winfield Area

description.value: Super 8 by Wyndham Lake Country/Winfield Area is a budget chain motel situated on the Okanagan Highway in the Lake Country/Winfield community north of Kelowna. Part of the global Wyndham Hotels network, it offers roadside accessibility along a popular Okanagan cycling corridor. As a franchise property, amenities can vary from the brand standard and would need direct confirmation for cyclist-specific needs.

address.value: 9564 Highway 97 North, Lake Country, BC V4V 1T7
